name: What is the difference between a custom home builder and a design-build firm?

mainEntity.name: Is design-build better than hiring a separate architect and builder for a custom home?
mainEntity.text: Is design-build better than hiring a separate architect and builder for a custom home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main difference is how responsibilities are organized. A custom builder usually comes in after the design is developed and manages the physical construction. A design-build firm combines design and construction into one coordinated process, which can improve speed, communication, and budget control. For Los Angeles custom homes, design-build can be helpful because planning, permitting, engineering, and construction decisions are tightly connected. The tradeoff is that some owners prefer a separate architect for more independent design exploration. The better choice depends on whether the homeowner values tighter budget control and fewer handoffs, or more separation between design and construction roles. The best firms clearly explain who handles drawings, permits, cost estimating, and field changes.
acceptedAnswer.description: A custom home builder typically manages construction, while a design-build firm handles both design and construction under one team. Design-build can reduce coordination problems, but separate contracts may offer more independent design control.
